title: my win rate was ~70% my first year and I was still losing money.
author: obdaytrader1994
selftext:
ok so this is kind of embarrassing but whatever.

first year trading I was weirdly proud of my win rate. like I'd check it more than my actual P&L. \~70%, felt great.

then one week three trades just ate almost two months of gains. didn't even feel like I did anything crazy. I was still "winning" most days lol

saw that wsb post last month, the guy who lost $268k on 0dte with an 80%+ win rate over like 8k trades, and honestly it was a little too familiar. obviously way smaller numbers for me but same exact pattern. small wins, then one loss that undoes everything.

what actually helped wasn't some new strategy. I just started asking myself before every trade, ok but how likely is price to even get there today??

I used to just pull levels off a chart and assume they'd hit. now before the open I use this tool that maps the day off the options book, and it has an AI you can just ask stuff. so I literally type "what are the odds price touches X today" for my target and then my stop. first time I did it, it told me my target had like an 18% chance of even getting touched and my stop was way more likely. and it was super clear that's a probability, not a call. I'd been taking that kind of trade for MONTHS thinking it was a good setup 🙃

it's not magic, it doesn't tell you what to trade and it's wrong plenty. but it made me skip a lot of trades I shouldn't have been in.

anyway. still figuring stuff out. but I stopped thinking "I win a lot" = "I'm good at this"

what's the thing you were proud of in your first year that turned out to be meaningless? feel like everyone has one

comments.author: ogb-officials
comments.body: What is your R:R? What tool teaches you to skip trades? For me I was never proud of anything in my first year..  I just wish I leant better and automate some stuff

replies.author: obdaytrader1994
replies.body:
haha fair, maybe "proud" is a strong word, more like it was the one number that made me feel ok 😅
R:R I aim for around 1:2 now, but the bigger change was checking if the target is even realistic before I take it.

the tool is morphic.trade

it doesn't teach you to skip trades or tell you what to do, it just gives the odds on each SPX/ES level before the open. the skipping part is on me, it's just hard to take a trade when you see the target has like an 18% chance of getting touched lol

and on automating, same, that's my next thing. it actually has an MCP server so you can pull the daily map into Claude or other AI tools, been playing with that a bit. what are you trying to automate?

comments.author: Visible_Let_7292
comments.body:
haha fair enough. honestly a lot of people just build those systems to feel productive while the account bleeds out anyway.

feels way better to just admit it's a grind.
